# M5 fixtures — external information in the shapes analysts actually have

Synthetic, no patient data. `mcp/test_external_e2e.py` reads each file through
`bregsurv_agent.external` and checks the outcome below. The xlsx and rds shapes
are generated by the test itself into a temporary directory (they need
openpyxl / R to write). Real SRTR release files are kept OUTSIDE the repository
as private fixtures (see `real_data/external_fixtures/`, not in git).

| file | shape | expected |
|---|---|---|
| coefs_two_columns.csv | variable, coefficient | coefficients, 6 terms, log scale (heuristic path) |
| paper_table_hr_ci.csv | Variable, HR, 95% CI lower/upper, p | coefficients, 5 terms, HR logged, CI brackets |
| bad_ci.csv | as above, one interval does not bracket | REFUSED ci_does_not_bracket |
| per_level.csv | predictor, level, coefficient | REFUSED names_not_unique |
| coefs_and_vcov.json | records + dict-of-dicts covariance | coefficients_with_covariance, Q = inverse, se recorded |
| vcov_singular.json | rank-1 covariance | REFUSED covariance_singular |
| vcov_names_mismatch.json | covariance names differ | REFUSED matrix_names_mismatch |
| coefs_dict.json | {"age": 0.51, ...} | coefficients, 5 terms |
| baseline_hazard.csv | time, hazard, cumulative_hazard | baseline_hazard read; with coefficients: coefficients_with_baseline_hazard |
| bad_cumhaz.csv | cumulative column offset from t=12 (still monotone) | REFUSED cumhaz_not_running_sum |
| individual_external.csv | the demo cohort's columns, 120 rows | individual_level_data |
| notes_only.csv | no numeric table | REFUSED no_coefficient_table |
